LanguageData.JJK_Settings_Overview: Settings apply to all colonies. Defaults preserve Rim-Kaisen's original balance. Hover over an option for details.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_Reset: Reset all Rim-Kaisen settings to defaults
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_NaturalGeneChance_Tip: Chance for a newly generated ordinary humanlike pawn to receive random sorcery or heavenly restriction. Default: 7%. Keeps the original reserve distribution and random technique selection. Does not change existing pawns, dedicated sorcerer pawn kinds, or xenotypes. Zero disables this random roll.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_GradeXpFactor_Tip: Scales newly earned sorcerer grade XP. Default: 100%. Does not change accumulated XP, grade requirements, or the daily paid-cast allowance.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_MasteryXpFactor_Tip: Scales new technique mastery from casting, kills, training, study and other mastery rewards for all sorcerers. Default: 100%. Rewards round to whole XP, with a minimum of one. Existing mastery, unlock requirements and practice limits are unchanged.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_RCTAwakeningFactor_Tip: Scales the chance to awaken Reverse Cursed Technique after surviving a qualifying severe hostile-combat downing. Default: 100% (5% chance, or 10% with RCT research). Zero prevents success for new opportunities. Existing near-death opportunities keep their saved chance; changing this option does not reroll them.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_BlackFlashChanceFactor_Tip: Scales random Black Flash on successful player-sorcerer melee hits, including the low-mood bonus. Default: 100% (6% normally, 10% at low mood). Zero disables random Black Flash. Damage, energy restoration and scripted Black Flash effects are unchanged.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_Manifestations_Tip: Allows ambient cursed spirit packs sent by storytellers, including Kenjaku's manifestation schemes. Default: on. Disabling also blocks queued manifestations when they execute. Corpse curses, quests, raids and already spawned spirits are separate.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_DisasterIncidents_Tip: Allows random disaster curse boss arrivals and their escorts. Default: on. Disabling also blocks queued disaster arrivals when they execute. Does not remove existing bosses or disable expedition and contract bosses.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_CorpseCurseChanceFactor_Tip: Scales the hourly chance of corpses creating curses after exceeding the corpse score threshold. Default: 100%. The original chance is capped at 40% before this multiplier; the final chance cannot exceed 100%.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_CorpseCurseThreshold_Tip: Corpse score must exceed this value before curses can form on a home map. Default: 8. Each exposed humanlike corpse counts as 1; each animal corpse as 0.15. Buried corpses do not count. Higher values make corpse curses less likely.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_CorpseCurseCooldownDays_Tip: Cooldown after a successful corpse manifestation, in in-game days. Default: 0.75. Applied to future manifestations; an existing cooldown keeps its saved end time. Hourly checks and chance rolls can make the actual gap longer.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_CurseThreatFactor_Tip: Scales the threat points used for manifestation packs, corpse curses and disaster curse escorts. Default: 100%. Higher values can produce more or stronger spirits, subject to existing pack limits. Does not scale the disaster boss itself, quests, expeditions, faction raids or existing spirits.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_ResidueDropFactor_Tip: Scales cursed residue dropped by future exorcisms. Default: 100%. Amounts round to whole items; zero disables residue drops. Boss technique remnants and other loot are unchanged.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_GizmoSize_Tip: Size of cursed technique command buttons. Default: 100%. Reduce this to fit more commands on screen.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_CombatSounds_Tip: Play Rim-Kaisen's added combat sound cues. Default: on.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_CombatOverlays_Tip: Show Rim-Kaisen's combat boundaries and warning labels. Default: on. Hiding them can make incoming attacks harder to anticipate.
